import json
from pathlib import Path
import random
import statistics

import chess

root=Path('/workspace/HarbiChess');directory=root/'artifacts/ufuk-offline-control-arena-20261004'
book=json.loads((root/'docs/research/UFUK-offline-control-opening-splits-20261004.json').read_text())
reports={};plies=0
for name in ['candidate-vs-initial','candidate-vs-stockfish512','initial-vs-stockfish512']:
    d=json.loads((directory/(name+'.json')).read_text());assert len(d['games'])==48
    assert d['source_commit']=='bbdac81feead83971304a8be728fa0cbddfcf061'
    initial='18f2aae5a4dca317229b87af17ee393a4e786db3369e54aaf32c926a811cb5ae'
    final='ef2ee1d26bb9b0e80a9e849009c7ed326b43afe9a9881f0160ad2cb14a6dc96a'
    assert d['candidate_sha256']==(initial if name.startswith('initial') else final)
    assert d['seed']==20261019 and d['neural_simulations_per_move']==16
    assert d['neural_threads']==1 and d['max_plies']==400
    if name=='candidate-vs-initial':assert d['opponent_sha256']==initial
    else:
        assert d['stockfish_sha256']=='0f83d24cc46d2c66c60f16001af5444873bc112b7d028594513426894c12da19'
        assert d['stockfish_nodes']==512 and d['stockfish_threads']==1 and d['stockfish_hash_mib']==16
    assert d['opening_source_sha256']=='34436236462ca16d6802a3b85398ef51a4eac2d1bb6c849e70e874276a2b8bac'
    assert d['candidate_root_actions']==4
    if name=='candidate-vs-initial':assert d['opponent_root_actions']==4
    trace=[json.loads(s) for s in (directory/(name+'-progress.jsonl')).read_text().splitlines()]
    assert [e['game'] for e in trace if e['type']=='game_end']==d['games']
    for i,g in enumerate(d['games']):
        assert g['candidate_color']==('white' if i%2==0 else 'black')
        opening=book['splits']['arena'][i//2]['opening']['moves'];assert g['moves'][:12]==opening
        b=chess.Board()
        for uci in g['moves']:
            m=chess.Move.from_uci(uci);assert m in b.legal_moves;b.push(m)
        ending=b.outcome(claim_draw=True)
        if ending is None:assert len(g['moves'])==400 and g['termination']=='max_plies' and g['score']==.5
        else:
            assert ending.termination.name.lower()==g['termination']
            expected=.5 if ending.winner is None else float(ending.winner==(g['candidate_color']=='white'))
            assert expected==g['score']
        assert len(g['move_wall_seconds'])==len(g['moves'])-12
        plies+=len(g['moves'])
        if 'stockfish' in name:
            engine_color=g['candidate_color']!='white'
            expected_plies=[p for p in range(13,len(g['moves'])+1) if ((p%2)==1)==engine_color]
            assert [n['ply'] for n in g['stockfish_nodes_by_move']]==expected_plies
            assert all(n['nodes']>=0 for n in g['stockfish_nodes_by_move'])
    times=[t for game in d['games'] for t in game['move_wall_seconds']]
    extra={'move_time_median_seconds':statistics.median(times),'move_time_p95_seconds':sorted(times)[int(.95*len(times))]}
    if 'stockfish' in name:
        nodes=[n['nodes'] for g in d['games'] for n in g['stockfish_nodes_by_move']]
        assert sum(nodes)==d['stockfish_actual_nodes'];extra={**extra,'actual_engine_nodes':sum(nodes),'engine_moves':len(nodes),'mean_actual_nodes':statistics.mean(nodes),'min_actual_nodes':min(nodes),'max_actual_nodes':max(nodes)}
    reports[name]={'summary':d['summary'],'wall_seconds':d['wall_seconds'],'nn_evaluations':d['evaluated_positions'],**extra}
narrow=reports['candidate-vs-stockfish512']['summary']['pair_scores'];wide=reports['initial-vs-stockfish512']['summary']['pair_scores']
effects=[a-b for a,b in zip(narrow,wide,strict=True)];rng=random.Random(20261019);samples=sorted(sum(rng.choices(effects,k=24))/24 for _ in range(10000))
result={'status':'pass','played_games':144,'legally_replayed_plies':plies,'durable_move_traces_match':True,'reports':reports,'stockfish_pair_score_delta':sum(effects)/24,'stockfish_delta_bootstrap_95':[samples[249],samples[9749]],'scope':'New stage uniform legal stress families; frozen shared/value and offline own-policy contribution, same narrow search. Historical inherited pretraining exposure incomplete; no natural-opening Elo or Stockfish-level claim.'}
(directory/'integrity-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(result))

for name,weights,opponent in [('candidate-vs-initial',candidate,str(initial)),('candidate-vs-stockfish512',candidate,'stockfish'),('initial-vs-stockfish512',initial,'stockfish')]:

    if opponent=='stockfish':cmd+=['--stockfish','/workspace/work/harbichess/stockfish/stockfish-linux-x86-64-universal','--record-engine-nodes']
    started=time.perf_counter();print(json.dumps({'starting':name}),flush=True)
    try:
        result=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=source,env={**os.environ,'PYTHONPATH':str(source/'src')},capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=900)

    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
        receipt={'command':cmd,'returncode':None,'wall_seconds':time.perf_counter()-started,'error':'registered whole-arm timeout','stdout':str(error.stdout),'stderr':str(error.stderr)}
    (directory/(name+'-command.json')).write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
    if receipt['returncode']!=0:raise RuntimeError('arena incomplete; preserve durable traces, no extension')
    data=json.loads((directory/(name+'.json')).read_text());results[name]=data['summary'];print(json.dumps({'finished':name,'summary':data['summary'],'wall_seconds':receipt['wall_seconds']}),flush=True)
